hotspots.title: Iran's revenge threats against Western leaders
hotspots.blurb: Iranian state media published a 'revenge list' targeting Western leaders, including Italy's Giorgia Meloni, Donald Trump, and others, for alleged involvement in the death of Ayatollah Khamenei. The list has sparked international condemnation and solidarity with the threatened leaders.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-stakes geopolitical tensions and the direct threats to prominent political figures, invoking fear and moral outrage.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen's eligibility crisis

hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high affective investment in Le Pen's political career and the moral charge around her legal battles and far-right policies.

hotspots.title: AfD's Saxony-Anhalt 100-day plan
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) unveiled a controversial 100-day plan for Saxony-Anhalt, including stricter immigration policies, mandatory work for asylum seekers, and increased deportations. This has sparked significant backlash and debate over the party's extremist tendencies.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high affective investment in AfD's rise, the alarmist framing of their policies, and the polarized contention over immigration and national identity.

hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high affective investment in historical grievances, polarized contention over EU expansion, and moral outrage over perceived national betrayals.
